project.name: Netbeans Plugin Kotlin Fixes Impl
project.description: K2 quick-fix action classes compiled from submodules/IntellijCommunity (code-insight/api, frontend-independent/quickfix, code-insight/fixes-k2) plus standalone extracted fix classes for private inner types. Exposes KotlinPsiUpdateModCommandAction (with public invoke()) and all concrete fix classes (AddDataModifierFix, RemoveArgumentFix, etc.) for use by the NetBeans adapter layer in the Nbm module.
